correctness.rationale: In any cactus all edge cycles are separate blocks; the forest law factors across bridge/cycle blocks. For two distinct endpoints of a traversed cycle, connectivity means all missing edges lie in one of two complementary arcs. Overlay two arc partitions into four cells with failure odds a,b,c,d. Conditional cycle covariance numerator is S Z - U V; independently expanded it in SymPy and exactly verified the stated sum ad[(a+d)(1+b)(1+c)+b+c+bc]+bc[(b+c)(1+a)(1+d)+a+d+ad]+2abcd. Every two nontrivial row/column partitions have a nonzero diagonal cell-pair (ad>0 or bc>0), giving strict positivity. Multiplying independent block expectations yields global covariance positive iff routes share at least one block, otherwise independence. The symbolic identity is an exact all-weight certificate, not merely numerical testing.
